tools.name: get_current_page_context
tools.description: Returns public context about the travel website page currently visible to the user. Use it to understand the active site, page, language, and topic before helping with the page.

tools.name: show_matching_tours
tools.description: Applies the supplied criteria to the visible tour search interface, preserves filters that were not supplied, and opens matching public tour results. Use when the user wants to find or filter trips on this site.

query.description: A public tour name or search phrase to show in the visible tour results.

category.description: A tour category slug or the visible category name, such as umre-turlari or Umre Turları.

month.description: Departure month as a number from 1 to 12.
